decisions.statement: One run is in flight at a time.
An ask arriving mid-run is run once that run ends.
An ask arriving mid-run replaces the ask already waiting.
The ask waiting is taken up by the run in flight rather than by the caller that asked.
A caller whose ask is left waiting waits on the run in flight and returns.
A run that throws leaves the ask behind that run to run all the same.
A throw is answered once nothing is left waiting.
Two runs that throw are answered with the first of the two throws.
A caller left waiting is answered with no throw from a run that is not its own.
Every ask has a whole picture.
The newest ask repeats every earlier ask.
Nothing here knows a run's work.

definition: one run at a time, with the newest ask run after the run in flight
